title: Project Command Center update manifest
description: Published alongside each release HTML asset. This file documents the format for anyone consuming a release; the application and CI both validate manifests with validateUpdateManifest() in src/updater/manifest.js, so that one implementation is the authority and cannot drift from a parallel schema.

formatVersion.description: Version of this manifest format. Incremented only when the manifest shape changes in a way older applications cannot read.

appVersion.description: Application version of the release asset. Independent of schemaVersion.

schemaVersion.description: Data Capsule schema this release writes.

minSchemaVersion.description: Oldest Data Capsule schema this release can migrate from. A file older than this needs an intermediate release.

channel.description: Release channel. Only stable is published today.

assetName.description: Bare file name of the release HTML asset in the same GitHub Release. Must not contain a path separator.

sha256.description: SHA-256 of the exact release asset bytes, as 64 lowercase hex characters. May carry a 'sha256:' prefix, matching the digest form GitHub reports for release assets.

publishedAt.description: ISO 8601 timestamp for when the release was built.

releaseNotes.description: Optional human-readable notes shown in the update review panel.

signature.description: Reserved for future signed releases. Null means unsigned, which is the expected state for v4. The field exists now so adding signatures later does not require a new formatVersion.
